data.cultural_impact: The term "Tirtharth" holds great cultural significance in Hinduism as it represents an individual who has traversed the spiritual journey and has attained a state of spiritual enlightenment. This term highlights the importance of the spiritual journey and the significance of reaching a state of spiritual growth and self-realization. In Hindu culture, sacred places (tirthas) are often considered to be powerful sites of spiritual growth and are revered as places of pilgrimage. The term Tirtharth encapsulates the idea of having crossed over the temporal and material aspects of life to reach the ultimate spiritual goal.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Tirtharth represents the attainment of self-knowledge and spiritual awakening. It symbolizes the transcendence of the mundane and the attainment of the divine. This name signifies someone who has crossed the threshold of worldly desires and has journeyed within to discover the true self. The ultimate goal of every spiritual seeker is to achieve this state of self-realization and to attain union with the divine. The name Tirtharth serves as a constant reminder of the spiritual journey that every individual must undertake to discover the true self and realize the ultimate reality of the universe.

historical_references.reference: Puranic text 'Brahma Vaivarta Purana' mentions a sage named Tirtharathi, also known as Tirthartha, who was a disciple of sage Vyasa and a great devotee of Lord Vishnu. He is said to have instructed the Pandavas and later, the Pancha Pandavas (the five sons of Yudhishthira) in the path of dharma and spirituality. The text also describes his penance and attainment of divine vision.

Another reference can be found in the 'Mahabharata', where Tirtharathi (also called Tirthartha) is mentioned as a descendant of sage Angirasa and a great sage and teacher. He is said to have performed severe penances to gain the boon of a divine vision of Lord Vishnu. His life and teachings are described as a source of inspiration for those seeking spiritual growth.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Tirtharth continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.

name_in_real_life.story: Maya Tirtharth, a teacher in Bangalore, India, shares that their name Tirtharth meaning "Ford or Crossing" has been a constant source of inspiration, motivating them to follow Hindu values and serve their community.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Tirtharth signifies the one who has traversed various spiritual pilgrimages, attaining wisdom and purification along the journey. It symbolizes the seeker's dedication to the quest for enlightenment and self-realization.
